title: Form balanced-role squads
description: Implement form_squads(candidates). Each record is [name, role, score]; names are unique. Group by role and sort each group by descending score, then name. Form as many complete squads as possible, one candidate from every role, in alphabetical role order. Return [squads, leftover_names], with leftovers alphabetical. Each squad contains names only. Empty input returns [[], []].
hints: The smallest role group determines the number of full squads.
